chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from al-Abbas b. Ma'ruf from Abu Ishaq from al-Hasan b. Ziyad al-Attar. He said:

I said to Abu Abdillah [Imam al-Sadiq] (as): The saying of the Messenger of Allah that "Fatima is the Mistress of the Women of the People of Paradise" - was she [only] the Mistress of the Women of her world? He said: That is Maryam. Fatima is the Mistress of the Women of the People of Paradise from the former and the latter peoples.

So, I said: So, the saying of the Messenger of Allah (s) that "al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise"? He said: They are, by Allah, the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise from the former and the latter peoples.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about Fatima being the Mistress of the Women of Paradise and Hasan and Husayn being Masters of the Youth of Paradise?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq, al-Hasan ibn Ziyad al-Attar asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the Prophet's saying that Fatima is the Mistress of the Women of Paradise - was she only the mistress of the women of her own world? The Imam clarifies that being mistress of the women of her era applies to Maryam (Mary), while Fatima holds the higher rank of being the Mistress of the Women of Paradise from the first to the last generations. The questioner then asks about the Prophet's saying regarding al-Hasan and al-Husayn being the Masters of the Youth of Paradise, and the Imam emphatically confirms, swearing by Allah, that they are indeed the Masters of the Youth of Paradise from the first to the last generations. This teaching was given in the context of clarifying the universal and eternal nature of the Ahl al-Bayt's elevated status.
